name: camera
title: Camera
description: Access your webcam directly from Vicinae. Preview a refreshing live feed or capture an instant photo without leaving the launcher.
author: samumatic

commands.name: open-camera
commands.title: Camera Preview
commands.subtitle: Live preview or capture a photo
commands.description: Detect connected cameras, show a refreshing live preview, and capture photos without leaving Vicinae.

commands.name: take-photo
commands.title: Take Photo
commands.subtitle: Quickly capture from your default camera
commands.description: Capture a still photo from your default (or first detected) camera without opening a view.

preferences.name: default_device
preferences.title: Default Camera Device
preferences.description: Video device path used for quick capture, e.g. /dev/video0. Leave empty to auto-select the first detected camera.

preferences.name: save_directory
preferences.title: Save Directory
preferences.description: Folder where captured photos are saved.

preferences.name: resolution
preferences.title: Capture Resolution
preferences.description: Requested capture resolution, used for both the live preview and captured photos. 'Auto' lets the camera negotiate its own default.

preferences.name: copy_to_clipboard
preferences.title: Copy to Clipboard
preferences.label: Copy captured photos to the clipboard
preferences.description: Automatically copy each photo to the clipboard right after it is captured.

preferences.name: open_after_capture
preferences.title: Open After Capture
preferences.label: Open captured photos automatically
preferences.description: Automatically open each photo in your default image viewer right after it is captured.
